decks.title: 高频固定搭配
decks.description: make / take / have / do / get 等最常用动词的固定搭配

cards.hint: make + 名词，不用 do · She made a decision about her career.
固定搭配，不说 do a mistake · I made a mistake in the report.
不可数，不能说 make a progress · She is making good progress in English.
effort 可数，用 an · You need to make more effort.
常说 make a big difference · Your help made a real difference.
主语通常是 it / that · That makes sense to me.
make + money 固定 · He makes money by selling software.
用复数 friends · She made friends quickly at school.
make an appointment with sb · I'd like to make an appointment with Dr. Li.
make a plan for sth · We made a plan for the weekend.
make a choice between A and B · You have to make a choice.
也可说 make a call · I need to make a phone call.
常用于餐厅、酒店 · I made a reservation for two.
make a suggestion · Can I make a suggestion?
后接 that 从句 · Make sure you lock the door.
make an excuse for sth · Don't make excuses for being late.
keep / break a promise · He made a promise to his son.
make a complaint about sth · She made a complaint about the service.
make a contribution to sth · Everyone made a contribution to the project.
常用复数 arrangements · We made arrangements for the trip.
make a discovery · Scientists made an important discovery.
make a fortune · He made a fortune in real estate.
make a habit of doing · Make a habit of reading daily.
固定搭配 make the bed · Please make your bed.
make + 三餐（breakfast/lunch/dinner） · I make breakfast every morning.
反义 make a loss · The company made a big profit.
make an offer on sth · They made an offer on the house.
make an announcement · The boss made an announcement this morning.
take a break from sth · Let's take a break for ten minutes.
take a look at sth · Take a look at this report.
较正式的请坐用语 · Please take a seat.
take / have a shower · I take a shower every morning.
同义 go for a walk · Let's take a walk after dinner.
take a photo of sth · She took a photo of the sunset.
take a risk · Sometimes you have to take a risk.
take a chance on sth · I'll take a chance and apply.
take a test / exam · I'm taking an exam next week.
常用复数 notes · Please take notes during class.
take a nap · He took a nap after lunch.
take care of sb / sth · She takes care of her little brother.
take part in an activity · We took part in the meeting.
不及物，无被动语态 · The meeting will take place tomorrow.
take advantage of sth · Take advantage of this opportunity.
take responsibility for sth · He took responsibility for the mistake.
take turns doing sth · We take turns washing the dishes.
take action on sth · The government took action to stop it.
take time to do sth · Learning a language takes time.
take measures to do sth · They took measures to cut costs.
take a step forward · We took a big step forward.
take pride in sth · She takes pride in her work.
take medicine · Remember to take your medicine.
take effect · The new law takes effect next month.
have / hold a meeting · We have a meeting at nine.
have / throw a party · They're having a party on Saturday.
have fun doing sth · The kids had fun at the park.
have a good time · Did you have a good time?
have a chat with sb · Let's have a chat over coffee.
have a conversation with sb · We had a long conversation.
have a look at sth · Have a look at this picture.
have / take a rest · You should have a rest.
have + 三餐 · I have breakfast at seven.
have a drink · Let's have a drink after work.
同义 catch a cold · I have a bad cold.
have a headache · She has a headache today.
have a fever · The baby has a fever.
have an idea for sth · I have an idea for the project.
have an opportunity to do · We have an opportunity to learn.
have a problem with sth · I have a problem with my computer.
have difficulty doing sth · He has difficulty sleeping.
have an effect on sth · The change had a big effect.
have a question about sth · I have a question about the task.
have a dream · She has a dream of becoming a doctor.
have / take a bath · He had a hot bath.
have access to sth · Students have access to the library.
have an advantage over sb · We have an advantage over them.
have no idea · I have no idea where he is.
have a feeling that… · I have a feeling it will rain.
have an influence on sb · Parents have a big influence on kids.
do homework（无冠词） · I do my homework after dinner.
housework 不可数 · She does housework on weekends.
do / wash the dishes · I'll do the dishes tonight.
do the laundry · He does the laundry on Sundays.
do business with sb · We do business with that company.
do sb a favor · Could you do me a favor?
do one's best to do · I'll do my best to help.
do research on sth · She's doing research on cancer.
do a good / great job · He did a great job on the project.
do exercise · I do exercise every morning.
do harm to sth · Smoking does harm to your health.
do damage to sth · The storm did damage to the roof.
do the shopping · I do the shopping on Fridays.
do the cooking · Who does the cooking in your home?
get married to sb · They got married last year.
get divorced · They got divorced after ten years.
get dressed · Hurry up and get dressed.
get lost · I got lost in the city.
get + 形容词 = 变得… · I get tired easily these days.
get ready for sth · Get ready for the meeting.
get angry with sb · Don't get angry with me.
get a job · She got a job at a bank.
get a degree in sth · He got a degree in computer science.
get a chance to do · I got a chance to travel.
get in touch with sb · I'll get in touch with you later.
get rid of sth · I want to get rid of these old clothes.
get used to doing sth · I got used to the cold weather.
get along with sb · She gets along with her coworkers.
get involved in sth · He got involved in the project.
get to know sb · I got to know my neighbors.
get home（不加 to） · I got home at six.
get better · The weather is getting better.
get worse · His condition got worse.
get a promotion · She got a promotion last month.
get a raise · He got a raise this year.
get the message · I get the message now.
get in / into trouble · He got in trouble at school.
get out of sth · I want to get out of this meeting.
get on（bus / train） · Get on the bus quickly.
get off（bus / train） · I get off at the next stop.
get up · I get up at six.
get over sth · It took time to get over the illness.
